Privacy

Preparation of the final privacy notice. This text has not yet been approved for public launch.

Controller according to the company document

FLYWEISS DOO SOMBOR, Josićki put 85, Sombor, Serbia. Contact: office@flyweiss.com. Current company details must be checked before public launch.

Contact form

When you submit the contact form, your name, company (if provided), email address, area of interest, message, consent, selected language and page address are sent to Web3Forms to forward your enquiry by email to the configured FLYWEISS contact. Web3Forms processes form data on servers in the United States. The website itself uses no analytics or marketing trackers and sets no cookies. The selected language is part of the URL.

Email contact

An email link opens your configured email application. Your message is transmitted to us only when you send it. The final information about enquiry processing must reflect the procedures actually in use.

Website and hosting

The website is served as a static site through Shipvela. It includes no analytics or marketing services, externally loaded fonts or embedded maps. Technical access data may be processed by the hosting service; the specific retention periods still need to be completed.

Complete before public launch

In particular, complete the actual hosting and email providers, data categories, purposes and legal bases, recipients and transfers, retention periods, individual rights and complaint routes. These details must be reviewed for actual operations and the applicable legislation.
